abilities.name: Trophy Taker
abilities.originalText: This unit’s attacks that target a Character unit can: Re-roll hit rolls of 1  Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.text: Before the battle, in the Muster Armies step, for each leader and support unit in your army, you can select one friendly bodyguard unit that unit can lead. That unit will then lead that bodyguard unit for the battle and form an attached unit with it. Unless otherwise stated, each bodyguard unit can only have one leader unit and one support unit attached to it. See Attached Units (19)

abilities.name: Spear of Chogoris
abilities.originalText: This unit’s ranged attacks have [Assault]. When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to declare a charge. If the assault doctrine is active for this unit, this unit has +1 to advance rolls and charge rolls.
